info.name: Guesthouse Room Booking API
info.description: Tests from section 9 of the final report. Run the whole collection in order with the API running (`npm run dev`), after `npm run db:seed`. On Vercel or Floci set baseUrl to the API URL. The setup requests log in with the demo accounts from db/seed.js and create a fresh test room, so the tests do not depend on existing data. Dates are relative to today.

exec: const day = (n) => { const t = new Date(); t.setUTCDate(t.getUTCDate() + n); return t.toISOString().slice(0, 10); };

Availability and Calendar (Omar)
AV-01 Check free dates for a room
AV-02 Check dates that overlap a confirmed booking

exec: pm.test('not available, with the conflict', () => { pm.expect(body.available).to.eql(false); pm.expect(body.conflicts.length).to.be.above(0); });

item.name: AV-03 Block dates that overlap a confirmed booking
AV-04 Get the calendar for a month

exec: pm.test('grid with rooms, days and holidays', () => { pm.expect(body.rooms).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.days.length).to.be.within(28, 31); pm.expect(body.holidays).to.be.an('array'); });

pm.test('confirmed stay shown', () => { const room = body.rooms.find((r) => r.id === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('roomId'))); const night = room.nights.find((n) => n.date === pm.collectionVariables.get('d20')); pm.expect(night.status).to.eql('confirmed'); });

item.name: AV-05 Get the calendar for month 2026-13
AV-06 Get the occupancy report for a month

exec: pm.test('rate is booked nights divided by available nights', () => body.rooms.forEach((r) => { const expected = r.available_nights ? Math.round((r.booked_nights / r.available_nights) * 1000) / 10 : 0; pm.expect(r.occupancy_rate).to.eql(expected); }));

item.name: AV-07 Calendar request while Nager.Date is unreachable

request.description: Run this one with the internet disconnected on the API side, or with HOLIDAY_COUNTRY set to a code Nager.Date does not support and an empty holidays table. The calendar must still return 200, with cached or no holidays and a holiday_warning.

item.name: End-to-end
E2E-01a Guest searches for d80 to d82
E2E-01b Guest requests the stay
E2E-01c Staff confirm it, the guest is emailed

exec: pm.test('email sent through Resend (skipped when no key is set)', () => pm.expect(['sent', 'skipped']).to.include(body.email));

item.name: E2E-01d The calendar shows the stay as confirmed

exec: pm.test('confirmed on the calendar', () => { const room = body.rooms.find((r) => r.id === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('roomId'))); pm.expect(room.nights.find((n) => n.date === pm.collectionVariables.get('d80')).status).to.eql('confirmed'); });
